mission: Independently author novel C5A calibration examples and normative labels before any parser outputs. No parser scoring in this task.
requirements: At least4 genuinely meaningful structural/semantic patterns in EVERY cell; no trivial value-only templating to manufacture core count. Core examples must be individually authored/reviewable; variants explicitly UNREVIEWED derivatives, never counted as independently reviewed core.
family_isolation: Every new row must use a SMART operation topology absent from the supplied DEVELOPMENT topology denylist. Compound natural queries are permitted and necessary; no artificial inert padding merely to change topology. Do not read heldout files or reconstruct heldout content. A separate sealed auditor will only return collision IDs; collided NEW examples must be discarded/replaced.
benchmark_topology_definition: For SMART, ordered presence features: rating (rating/ratings/rated/stars or digit+), year (publish*/release*/year/after/before/onward), author (by), title (titled), negative (not/exclud*/without/except), include (include/included/subject/category), format (online/digital*/physical*/hardcover/binding), availability (available/request/loan/borrow), metadata (page/edition/language/french/dollar/costing/difficulty/audience), preference (beginner*/introduct*/advanced/research/reference/short*), sort (sort/highest/newest/oldest). Non-SMART modes are all already exposed development and cannot be new isolated parser-core cases; record that limitation rather than force literal modes. Hash/compute actual structural component from these features.
label_rules: No target confidence floats. SAFE_UNCERTAIN must have a real independent semantic basis (e.g. a uniquely defensible correction with visible interpretation); no artificial uncertainty for clear syntax.
Canonical negative subject is category-only; no duplicate broad exclude_terms unless actual wording requires broad text exclusion.
Title is strict only with explicit titled/called/named or explicit literal mode; free prefix before by remains semantic.
Scope capabilities authoritative. Unsupported fields must not be claimed enforceable. Contradictions require individually supported operands.
Record inapplicable/unresolved fields in metric_applicability; do not fabricate placeholders as gold.
Do not copy any development/old calibration query. Do not read old predictions, scores or failure reports.
independence: Fresh context; no root conversation inherited. No production parser imports/calls. Do not open other reports/source. You may use Python to write the cases and validate schema/dedup/structure, but semantic labels come from your authored specifications, never predictions. Core awaiting independent review; set review_status=UNREVIEWED until separate reviewer completes.
